title: Account Executive
description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

Joining Modo means three things:

  • We own the outcome, not the title. At Modo, you identify what needs doing and you do it - full responsibility for the work, the quality, and the outcome. This is a seat on a small, high-performing team: real autonomy, a warm market, and a product that's already the reference standard for battery storage globally.
  • We build the standard, not a workaround. We hire people who apply broad intelligence to new problems rather than pattern-matching to past ones. Your habits and playbook become the template as the team scales - this role shapes how Modo Energy sells in APAC, not just how you sell.
  • We stay close to the market. The customer is the most important person in everything we do, and that starts with you. Your proximity to customers makes you one of our best signals - insight flows back into product and research, not just into a CRM field. You'll be immersed in the energy sector, building a foundational network and feeding continuous insight back to the team.

If you're driven by ownership, pace, and building best in class approaches to the customer journey, we want to hear from you.

The Role

Modo Energy is hiring an Account Executive to own new business across Australia and the Asia-Pacific region. You'll run the full sales cycle - from first conversation to signed contract - selling our data and analytics platform to the investors, developers, and operators building the energy transition.

This is an early seat on a small, high-performing sales team. You'll have real autonomy, a warm market to work with, and a product that's already the reference standard for battery storage globally. The people you're selling to have heard of Modo Energy; your job is to convert that awareness into revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Strategise, Plan and Execute on your book of business. Owning the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, demo, negotiation, and close.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of mid-market and enterprise accounts across APAC
  • Deliver compelling demonstrations of the Modo Energy Terminal, connecting product capability directly to customer problems
  • Negotiate and close deals valued between $60,000 and $300,000
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities within your book of business
  • Forecast accurately in HubSpot and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene
  • Feed customer insight back into product and go-to-market strategy
  • Represent Modo Energy at industry events, conferences, and client meetings

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally selling data, research, or analytics products.
  • A track record of hitting quota in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-threaded deals (broadly in the $60k–$300k range).
  • The ability to translate technical product value into commercial language - for a trader, a developer, and a CFO alike.
  • Comfort with ambiguity - energised by building a playbook, not just running one.
  • Energy market experience is a strong plus, not a requirement.

What's In It For You

  • Real ownership from day one. Working alongside leaders in the industry, inside a company defining a new category in the global energy market.
  • A warm market and a product with proof. You're not creating demand from nothing - you're converting recognition into revenue.
  • Direct exposure to building with AI. Ko, our AI analyst, is central to how the whole company works - every person at Modo uses it and makes it better. You'll build real AI-sector experience, using every tool available to cover more ground than a traditional sales role allows.
  • Pay that reflects your personal market value, not a title band
  • An in-person environment built for people who want to build, not coast. Hybrid (Tuesday to Thursday in office) across our London, New York, Madrid, and Sydney offices. Sydney CBD location at Grosvenor Place by Circular Quay.

Modo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation
For Sydney Applicants, the salary range for this position is $120k - $140k (double OTE) per year.

What You Can Expect From Us

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Account Manager with start-up and/or SaaS experience. This role is critical in bridging the gap between our software development teams and our end users. You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate complexity and translate their business needs into impactful outcomes through our platform. If you’re passionate about the energy industry and driven to deliver outstanding customer success, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, lasting relationships with clients, including developers, utilities, and funds, supporting them in integrating Modo Energy’s solutions into their strategic decision-making processes while identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities to drive account growth.
  • You will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, focusing on account growth, retention, and achieving revenue targets.
  • Guide customers in using Modo Energy’s software suite to construct long-term power market scenarios, leveraging your expertise in power markets, while helping clients navigate and interpret complex results and resolving troubleshooting issues.
  • Collaborate with team leadership to coordinate resources and support strategic initiatives across the user base, ensuring alignment with client goals and product team insights.
  • Gather and communicate client feedback and pain points to the product team, contributing to continuous improvement and the product roadmap.
  • Oversee the integration of Modo Energy’s software suite into client operations, ensuring smooth adoption, proactively monitoring account health, and taking steps to prevent and resolve potential issues.
  • Understand client pain points and convey these back to the product teams to refine product roadmaps according to user needs. Monitor, track, and report on health of software accounts, taking proactive steps to anticipate and resolve incidents before escalation.
  • Implement initiatives to promote Modo Energy’s software community within the region and foster client engagement.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or sales, ideally within a SaaS, energy, or tech environment.
  • Experience in roles where you have carried a revenue target or have been involved in driving account growth is a key requirement.
  • Deep interest and knowledge of SaaS products; interest/experience in power markets/energy transition is a plus.

  • Confident stakeholder management abilities, able to collaborate cross-functionally to drive new initiatives.
  • Self-starter with a creative problem-solving approach.
  • Proven ability to analyze, interpret, and derive insights from complex quantitative data.
  • Preferred Skills: familiarity with CRM (Hubspot) and customer success platforms to monitor client health (Vitally) and track account growth opportunities.

About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 80+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid, backed by $30M in Series B funding, built with AI at the core, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a company defining a new category at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to join Modo's Customer Success team in New York.

Today, that model runs on a partnership: an Account Manager owns the strategic relationship, the "CEO" of the account, while the Customer Success Manager is the "COO," working directly with the end users, onboarding them, owning health metrics and adoption, and writing the playbook for what great customer success looks like at a company doing something this new. In London, that partnership is already in motion, with two CSMs paired against Account Managers today, and a third on the way.

New York is an even bigger version of that opportunity. You'll be the face of Modo for our US customer base, the person people want to sit across the table from, the one they call first, while working in close partnership with an Account Manager on the strategic side of each account. You'll be building your own way of doing things rather than stepping into a fully-formed process, and the knowledge you build of these accounts will shape how customer success works across the whole US team.

That's why this role suits someone who's already doing customer success well somewhere else, energy experience isn't required, a fintech, SaaS, or data company background is just as strong a fit, and who's ready for meaningfully more ownership and responsibility than they currently have.

We move quickly here: within your first 30 days, you'll be learning the product, our domain, and our customer base, and you'll run a full onboarding call walkthrough with the team. From day 60, you're taking customer calls yourself, with support close by if you need it, and within two to three months, you're running that relationship on your own. By six months, we'd expect you fully scaled: growing usage and activation across your accounts, helping the Account Manager spot and close upsell conversations, and contributing directly to the team's 90% gross revenue retention target, which is how we measure success in this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own onboarding for every new US customer, personally setting the relationship up so people know exactly who to go to and what to expect from Modo.
  • Since our pricing is usage-based, proactively drive usage across your accounts: notice early when engagement starts to dip, and find creative ways to bring it back up.
  • Be the primary point of contact for our US customer base, building the kind of relationship that makes customers want to pick up the phone.
  • Partner closely with the Account Manager, flagging account health, usage dips, and upsell opportunities as they come up.
  • Run regular training sessions, health check-ins, and calls, reading each customer to strike the right balance between getting straight to business and building the relationship.
  • Build the playbook as you go: document how you approach onboarding, adoption, and renewals so it scales as the US team grows.
  • Feed customer insight back to the product team so what you're hearing on calls shapes what we build next.

What We're Looking For

The Essentials

  • 2-4 years in a customer success or account management role in B2B SaaS or a similar customer-facing, portfolio-based role. Energy experience isn't required, fintech, SaaS, or data company backgrounds are a strong fit.
  • A track record of driving product adoption and owning account health proactively, not just reporting on it after the fact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to read the room, whether a customer wants to get straight to business or build a relationship first.
  • Genuinely proactive: the kind of person who notices a dip in usage before it becomes a problem and finds their own way to fix it.
  • Someone who wants ownership, not a fully-built process to follow. Much of this role is still to be written, and that's the appeal.

Nice To Have

  • Experience in the energy sector or with energy markets, particularly useful in the US, where the market differs meaningfully from Europe.
  • Familiarity with customer success or health-scoring tools such as Vitally, Gainsight, Intercom, or HubSpot
  • Experience working in close partnership with an Account Manager or sales counterpart.

Compensation & Equal Opportunity

  • For New York Applicants, the salary for this position is $90K-$110K per year, depending on experience, plus 20% variable.
  • Equity
  • 25 days PTO plus 10 paid Holidays annually
  • 100% employer paid medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with matching

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State, or New York City law.

title: Frontend Engineer (AI/Platform)
description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

Modo Energy's engineering team builds the systems behind the Modo Terminal, the data, research, and agentic platform that energy market professionals rely on every day. We're growing fast, and our ambitions are growing faster: from a data and research product to an agentic layer that lets users work with our domain knowledge through natural language and AI-assisted tools.

We're hiring frontend engineers to join one of our product teams: Terminal, Data, Ko (our AI Analyst), or Modelling. Each team owns a business capability end-to-end, including its own frontend, backend, and infrastructure, and every team ships to production independently, without centralized approval. Wherever you land, you'll help shape a shared TypeScript, React, and Next.js codebase in a monorepo built for rapid, AI-assisted development, and you'll build against a company-wide design system so what you ship stays consistent with the rest of the product.

We're looking for engineers who learn fast and go wide. You won't be boxed into pixel-pushing; the best people on our teams move fluidly between component architecture, performance work, and the backend or infrastructure basics behind the features they build. If you're the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool, library, or part of the stack without needing much of a runway, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Help shape the technical direction of our frontend monorepo so it scales with the team and the product.
  • Design and build components in our internal UI library, built on MUI, that the rest of the team can build on.
  • Build and improve high-performance, low-latency interfaces that hold up under real, live market data.
  • Write well-tested code (Jest, Cypress, or Playwright) and contribute to how the team reviews and documents its work.
  • Split your time between shipping new features and keeping things healthy: maintenance, performance, and production issues are a normal, expected part of the job, not an interruption to it.
  • Work directly with design and with the people who understand the domain (energy analysts, data scientists) to bridge the gap between design and engineering.
  • Cross into the backend and infrastructure basics behind your own features when the team needs it: an API change, a deployment fix, a bit of the pipeline behind the data you're rendering.

What We're Looking For

The Essentials

  • 3+ years of professional frontend development experience, with excellent TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
  • Experience with MUI or a similar component library.
  • Solid testing practice with frameworks like Jest and Cypress or Playwright.
  • Proficient with Git, Docker, and CI/CD workflows, and familiar with monorepo structures and tools (Turborepo, Yarn Workspaces, or similar).
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar). We write a lot of code this way.
  • An eye for design (UI/UX): you can build polished, aesthetically pleasing interfaces, not just functional ones.
  • A fast learner with good judgement, comfortable making calls on component design and what's good enough to ship, and genuinely energized by picking up unfamiliar tools, stacks, or problem areas rather than staying in one lane.
  • Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where you're expected to figure things out, make trade-offs, and ship, with real autonomy over how.

Nice to have

  • Start-up or scale-up experience.
  • Familiarity with Python.
  • Experience with energy markets.

Equal Opportunity

title: Global Gas Analyst
description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Global Gas Analyst to build an entirely new function at Modo Energy and to become the face of it while you do.

Modo Energy already gives 200+ clients the clearest read on battery and power markets anywhere. Gas sits upstream of almost all of it, and right now nobody owns that picture. This role is about building it from scratch: the models, the data, the forecasts, and the research that show our clients how gas is moving and what it means for their portfolios.

As our Global Gas Analyst, you’ll design the process, put your name on the output, and prove what good looks like. If you've got the market knowledge and you're itching for the chance to build something that's genuinely yours with the autonomy, ownership, and client-facing visibility that a bigger company can't offer, this is that chance.

This is a global role, based in London and reporting to the Director of European Product.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build Modo's gas analytics capability from the ground up, including long term gas forecasts out to 2050 to 2060 and core datasets covering European gas storage, LNG, and global production.
  • Publish research that lands with our audience. You'll be judged on the strength of your models and on whether people actually read your work.
  • Get in front of clients directly to explain what's happening in gas markets and what it means for their portfolios.
  • Feed your gas view into Modo's regional power and storage models, working alongside the team as part of our new Global Analytics group (gas and supply chain).

What We're Looking For

The Essentials

  • 3 to 4 years' experience in gas analytics, from a major commodities house (e.g. Argus, Bloomberg), a gas trading desk, or similar, with enough market knowledge to work independently from day one. This is a sweet spot role: enough experience to have real judgement, not so much that you've already moved into management.
  • An entrepreneurial, self starter mindset. You'll be building this largely on your own, so you need to be comfortable setting your own direction rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  • Something that makes you stand out. That could be a strong academic record, a name brand employer, or a serious personal pursuit. The common thread we're looking for is someone who has shown they can commit to something and see it through to mastery.
  • Working knowledge of data analytics and coding (Python, databases). Modern AI tools have taken some of the weight off this. Deep gas market fluency is the rarer skill, and the one that will set you apart.
  • The confidence to hold your own in client conversations. You'll be the person clients turn to when they want to understand gas.

Nice To Have

  • Experience building or maintaining market forecasting models, whether in gas or an adjacent commodity. It shows you can take a forecast from a blank page to something clients rely on, which is exactly what this role asks of you.
  • Some grounding in coal markets. Coal and gas compete for the same slot on the power stack, so understanding one sharpens your read on the other. Not essential, but a genuine plus.
  • A real interest in power, battery storage, or the wider energy transition. Gas connects to all of it, and Modo's clients care about those links. The more of that picture you can see, the more useful your analysis will be to them.

Equal Opportunity

title: Growth Associate
description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

We're hiring a Growth Associate to help more people discover and sign up to Modo Energy.

This is a generalist role, and one of the most cross-functional in the company. You'll work directly with the Head of Product Marketing and touch almost every team in the business, marketing, product, and beyond, often in the same week. Because Modo runs its Australia and Europe marketing out of this office, you'll also work on a genuinely global scale: understanding what regional teams have built, why, who their customers are, and shaping campaigns for markets you won't always be sitting in.

Day to day, that might mean running a campaign for a new market launch, making a short video that shows what Ko (our AI Analyst) can do, writing an email that re-engages free users, or figuring out why people aren't converting and fixing it. The scope of this role will grow as we do, what it looks like in year two may look very different from day one. We can't promise you a fixed career path here; what we can promise is a lot of real responsibility, fast, and exposure to more of the business than most junior roles offer.

A big part of this role is product marketing. You'll need to get under the skin of what we build, market indices, revenue forecasts, Ko our AI analyst, and help set the standard for how we talk about it. We want to be best-in-class here: creative, sharp, and ahead of the rest of the industry in how we reach and engage our audience. That means having real opinions about what good looks like and the drive to execute on them.

We also want someone we can trust with the words that go out under Modo's name, customer emails, product comms, campaign copy, without needing every draft heavily reviewed. Strong written communication isn't a nice-to-have here; it's one of the main things we're hiring for.

We care about taste. If something looks or sounds wrong, say so.

And if you're excited about the energy transition, you'll fit right in. Modo Energy exists to help capital flow more efficiently into clean energy infrastructure, and understanding how power markets actually work is a big part of the job. If that sounds interesting rather than intimidating, that's a good sign.

Why now: we're at an inflection point in the US, where we've built out a lot of product and are investing heavily in go-to-market. This role is part of the team trying to help Modo scale and win in the US, which means the day-to-day will genuinely vary week to week, and you'll pick up a range of skills quickly that we think are especially valuable if you're entrepreneurial or considering founding something of your own down the line.

What You'll Do

  • Create content that helps people understand Modo Energy's products, short videos, emails, social posts, demos of Ko in action
  • Write and own customer-facing communications such as campaign emails, re-engagement sequences, and product comms, to a high bar with minimal need for rewriting
  • Run campaigns when new markets launch to get the right users to sign up, including for regions (Australia, Europe) you'll coordinate on remotely
  • Own the metrics that matter for top-of-funnel growth
  • Know what's converting, what's driving discovery, and where the biggest opportunities are
  • Report weekly, iterate fast, and make sure every decision we make is grounded in what's actually working
  • Drive adoption of new features through creative, targeted outreach
  • Help tell Modo Energy's story as the company scales into new markets
  • Work closely with product, and with regional teams, to understand context before you market it, you'll need to know enough about what's being built, and for whom, to represent it well

What We're Looking For

We hire for this role from two different directions — people with marketing backgrounds and people with more analytical/data backgrounds — and we're genuinely open to either. What matters more than your degree or your title so far is evidence you're a generalist: someone who's driving, curious, and doesn't need a defined lane to be effective.

The Essentials

  • A high, demonstrated willingness to learn and to pick up work outside your defined scope, we're looking for people who've shown this already (a founder-type project, something you built or ran independently, anything outside a formal job description)
  • You've shipped something independently, a project, a campaign, a newsletter, anything you took from idea to live
  • Strong written communication, clear, well-structured, and right for the reader. We're specifically looking for someone we can trust to draft customer-facing comms without heavy editing
  • Taste and judgement, you know good from bad and you'll say so
  • You use AI as a core part of how you work, not just chatbots, but building workflows, automating tasks, and using agents to get things done faster
  • Curious and resourceful, you figure things out without being told how, and you're comfortable asking the right questions when you don't have full context (you'll need this constantly, given how many teams this role touches)

Nice To Have

  • Comfortable with design or video tools: Figma, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar
  • An engineering or analytical mindset, you think in systems and would rather automate something than do it manually twice
  • Some experience with growth or marketing campaigns
  • An interest in energy, climate, or the transition to clean power
  • Degree in an analytical field: economics, engineering, maths, physics, or similar (we care more about how you think than what you studied)

Compensation & Equal Opportunity

  • Base salary range: $80,000–$120,000 per year, depending on experience.

title: Python Engineer (AI/Platform/Modelling/Data)
description:
About Modo Energy

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

The Role

Modo Energy's engineering team builds the systems behind the Modo Terminal, the data, research, and agentic platform that energy market professionals rely on every day. We're growing fast, and our ambitions are growing faster: from serving data and research to letting users (and their AI agents) query, forecast, and act on it directly.

We're hiring backend Python engineers to join one of our product teams: Terminal, Data, Ko (our AI Analyst), or Modelling. Each team owns a business capability end-to-end, including its own APIs, data pipelines, AWS infrastructure, and developer tooling. Wherever you land, you'll be building production systems from day one, with ownership over what you ship and how.

We're looking for engineers who learn fast and go wide. You won't be boxed into a single layer of the stack; the best people on our teams move fluidly between building a feature, hardening a pipeline, fixing an infra issue, and automating away the next one. If you're the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool, library, or part of the codebase without needing much of a runway, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs, on Django, FastAPI, or similar, that power a live product used daily by energy market professionals.
  • Design and operate data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve energy market data reliably and at scale.
  • Own AWS infrastructure and deployment end-to-end using Terraform, from local development through to production.
  • Build the monitoring, observability, and alerting that let your team catch problems before customers do.
  • Split your time between shipping new features and keeping the platform healthy. Maintenance, performance, and production issues are a normal, expected part of the job, not an interruption to it.
  • Design internal tools such as CLIs, APIs, and MCP servers that make your team and others faster, and that let both humans and AI agents work with our data safely and effectively.
  • Work directly with the people who understand the domain (energy analysts, data scientists, modellers) to make sure what you build is accurate and actually useful.
  • Contribute to the infrastructure behind our LLM-powered AI Analyst as needed: retrieval pipelines, tool-calling, and the plumbing that lets models work with real energy market data.
  • Cross into the parts of the stack outside your core comfort zone when the team needs it, whether that's a bit of frontend or a bit of deeper infra, and pick up what you don't already know.

What We’re Looking For

The Essentials

  • 3+ years of professional Python experience, with strong backend fundamentals. You write clean, well-structured code and are comfortable owning something end-to-end, from design through deployment and monitoring.
  • Real, hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). You've run production infrastructure, not just experimented with it.
  • Proficiency with Django, FastAPI, or a comparable async Python framework.
  • Experience with data pipelines and relational databases (PostgreSQL), and building systems that serve data reliably at scale.
  • Expert-level use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar). You know when to trust them, when to intervene, and how to get real leverage from them. We write a lot of code this way.
  • A fast learner with good judgement, comfortable making calls on system design and what's good enough to ship, and genuinely energized by picking up unfamiliar tools, stacks, or problem areas rather than staying in one lane.
  • Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where you're expected to figure things out, make trade-offs, and ship, with real autonomy over how.

Nice to have

  • Experience with LLM-powered applications: RAG pipelines, tool-calling architectures, or agentic systems.
  • Experience designing external-facing APIs, including versioning, backwards compatibility, and OpenAPI/REST standards.
  • Familiarity with data infrastructure such as Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, or Kafka.
  • Experience with energy markets.

Equal Opportunity

Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.
